import json
from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'i':4}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
({'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-12','s':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''},'error':None}),
({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'b':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
({'layers':[{'z':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})]
for n,(req,exp) in enumerate(cases):
 got=evaluate(req,p)
 assert got==exp,(n,got,exp)
p0={**p,'null_resets':False,'environment':False}
assert evaluate({'layers':[{'i':None}]},p0)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}
assert evaluate({'environment':{'i':'2'}},p0)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[evaluate(req,policy) for req in requests]
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for result in report: assert set(result)==set(schema['required'])
print('ok',len(cases)+2,'boundary cases and report')
